name: DVD Level
summary: DVD Level is an EA that trades based on key price levels (support/resistance or pivot points) to identify high-probability entry zones. It systematically opens positions when price interacts with these calculated levels, aiming to capture reversals or breakouts from significant price zones. The EA likely uses level-based logic to determine trade direction and manages positions with defined exit criteria.
summary_zh: DVD Level是一个基于关键价格水平（支撑/阻力或支点）进行交易的EA，用于识别高概率入场区域。当价格与这些计算出的水平线交互时，系统性地开仓，旨在捕获重要价格区域的反转或突破。该EA可能使用基于水平的逻辑来确定交易方向，并使用定义的出场标准来管理仓位。
strategy_analysis: DVD Level策略的核心概念是基于预先计算的价格水平线（DVD Level）来决定交易方向和入场时机。入场条件是当价格触及或突破这些关键水平时触发买入或卖出信号，可能在支撑位做多、阻力位做空，或者在突破后追单。出场条件可能包括固定止盈止损、水平线目标或价格行为确认。仓位管理方面，EA可能使用固定手数或基于资金比例的动态手数计算。资金管理方面，策略依赖水平线的准确性来控制风险，但具体是否有完善的资金管理规则取决于参数设置。整体而言，该策略的优势在于利用关键价格水平提供明确的交易框架，但风险在于水平线失效时可能产生连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of the DVD Level strategy is based on pre-calculated price levels (DVD Levels) to determine trade direction and entry timing. Entry conditions are triggered when price touches or breaks through these key levels, likely going long at support and short at resistance, or following through on breakouts. Exit conditions may include fixed take-profit and stop-loss, level-based targets, or price action confirmation signals. Position sizing may use fixed lots or dynamic lot calculation based on account equity percentage. Money management relies on the accuracy of the calculated levels to control risk, though the completeness of risk management rules depends on parameter configuration. Overall, the strategy benefits from using key price levels to provide a clear trading framework, but risks consecutive losses when levels fail to hold.

pros: 基于关键价格水平交易，逻辑清晰且具有市场结构依据
支撑阻力水平是经过验证的交易概念，在多个市场和时间框架有效
入场条件明确，价格触及水平即触发信号，避免情绪化交易
策略框架简单直观，便于理解和参数优化
pros_en: Trading based on key price levels provides clear logic grounded in market structure
Support/resistance levels are a proven trading concept effective across multiple markets and timeframes
Well-defined entry conditions triggered by price reaching levels eliminate emotional trading decisions
Simple and intuitive strategy framework that is easy to understand and optimize
cons: 关键水平的计算可能不够精确，市场假突破会导致频繁止损
缺乏对市场趋势环境的判断，可能在趋势行情中逆势交易
固定止损止盈可能无法适应不同市场波动条件
水平线失效时没有备用策略或过滤机制，可能产生连续亏损
cons_en: Level calculation may lack precision, and market false breakouts can trigger frequent stop-losses
Lacks trend environment assessment, potentially trading against the trend in trending markets
Fixed stop-loss and take-profit may not adapt to varying market volatility conditions
No backup strategy or filtering mechanism when levels fail, potentially leading to consecutive losses
improvements: 增加趋势过滤器（如均线方向），只在顺趋势方向的水平线信号入场
引入动态止损止盈，根据ATR或波动率自动调整风险参数
加入时间过滤和波动率过滤，避免在低流动性时段或重大新闻前后交易
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (e.g., moving average direction) to only take level signals in the direction of the prevailing trend
Implement dynamic stop-loss and take-profit based on ATR or volatility to automatically adjust risk parameters
Incorporate time and volatility filters to avoid trading during low liquidity sessions or around major news events

risk_points: 依赖价格水平的准确性，假突破可能导致不必要的亏损
缺乏多时间框架确认，单一周期水平线可能不够可靠
固定止损可能在剧烈波动时不足以覆盖市场噪音
risk_points_en: Relies on accuracy of price levels; false breakouts can cause unnecessary losses
Lacks multi-timeframe confirmation; single-period levels may not be reliable enough
Fixed stop-loss may be insufficient to cover market noise during high volatility

It systematically opens positions when price interacts with these calculated levels, aiming to capture reversals or breakouts from significant price zones. The EA likely uses level-based logic to determine trade direction and manages positions with defined exit criteria.
